# Acquisition test fixture

`DETERMINISTIC_NOT_ERA5_PAYLOAD.txt` is arbitrary text used only to test
restartable file acquisition and provenance receipts.

It is **not** ERA5, ERA5-HEAT, ERA5-Drought, reanalysis output, climate data, or
an observational sample. It contains no physical variables or values. Production
and sample-data code must never treat it as NetCDF input.
